description: The agent must: 1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the `/industry-map` command with `--template` and `--output` flags, then invoke it with `半导体` as the head node. 2) Use the provided template at `assets/半导体产业图谱_template.csv` as reference. 3) Generate a CSV with exactly 8 columns (id, name, level, parent_id, parent_name, path, classification, decision_basis), 400-1200 rows, hierarchical IDs in `1-1-1` dash format, path columns using `/` separator, level depth reaching 5-7. 4) Follow all node naming rules: no company names (no 台积电, 华为, ASML etc.), no punctuation in names, no parameter specs (no `7nm工艺`, `28nm节点`), no marketing adjectives. 5) Populate `decision_basis` for Level 5-7 nodes with technical explanations. 6) Generate the MD process record file with all 5 required sections including research rationale and reference sources. The key proprietary traps are: the exact ID dash-format (not dots), the decision_basis requirement for deep nodes, the strict node naming prohibition rules, and the specific 8-column CSV schema.
